rationale.ai-review: Demonstrates reliability limits and correlated errors of AI code reviewers.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Argues executable specifications are necessary to ground AI review pipelines.
rationale.counterpoint: Argues against prevailing reliance on pure AI-to-AI code review pipelines.
rationale.method-experiment: Conducted controlled experiments comparing AI review to BDD specifications.
rationale.agentic: Evaluates pipelines where agents review whole code artefacts.
rationale.risk-quality: Classifies structural and architectural code decay as Category D defects.
